TULONG-PINANSYAL SA MGA TODA! 

Daan-daang tricycle drivers mula sa Districts 2 at 6 ang nakatanggap ng P5,000 mula sa cash relief assistance program ng Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) ngayong Miyerkules.

Katuwang ng DSWD ang mga kawani ng Social Services Development Department (SSDD), at Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD) sa distribusyon ng tulong-pinansyal.

Kung kayo po ay lehitimong miyembro ng isang Tricycle Operators and Drivers Association (TODA) at hindi napabilang sa listahan, makipag-ugnayan lamang sa inyong asosasyon. Sila po ang magsusumite ng listahan sa Tricycle Regulatory Division (TRD) ng QC TTMD. May mga susunod pa pong batch ng pamimigay ng tulong para sa mga miyembro ng TODA.

PUBLIC ADVISORY 📢

Dry Run for the Implementation of Parking Regulation for Public Parking Space (Tomas Morato - Timog Avenue)

In line with the QC ReVibe beautification efforts in the city’s tourist districts, the Quezon City Government will be conducting a dry run for the implementation of parking regulations along Tomas Morato Avenue and Timog Avenue starting March 23, 2026 (Monday).

1. Parking in public parking areas will be FREE, on a first-come, first-served basis.
2. Vehicles will be allowed to park for a maximum of three (3) hours, after which, drivers must move their vehicles to a different public parking spot.
3. Parking tickets will be issued by attendants from the QC Transport and Traffic Management Department (TTMD) only. No other person can issue or collect any parking ticket.
4. Once three (3) hours have passed and the driver has not complied, TTMD attendants will issue a violation.
5. Collection of parking fees in any form is strictly prohibited and may be reported to the TTMD main office.

This parking regulation shall remain in effect until the passage of the PUBLIC PAY PARKING ORDINANCE. 

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.
